guide.guideIntro: Want a degree but can't attend a regular college? That's the situation millions of learners find themselves in, and it's exactly why IGNOU exists. Indira Gandhi National Open University is India's largest open university, and it offers programmes you can study from home, at your own pace. This guide explains what IGNOU is, which courses it offers, who can apply, how the process works and how to get the best from your studies.
guide.whatIsIgnou: IGNOU was established in 1985 by an Act of Parliament, with the aim of making higher education reachable for everyone. Indira Gandhi National Open University serves lakhs of learners across India and abroad through regional centres, study centres and online support. Its degrees are recognised by the UGC-DEB, so they're valid for jobs, promotions and further studies. whyChoose.intro: Open and Distance Learning removes the barriers of time, age and location. With IGNOU, you study at your own pace, attend optional counselling sessions at a nearby centre and appear for exams at designated centres. A few of the biggest advantages:
items: Affordable fees compared to regular universities
Flexible duration, with extra time to finish your programme
Study material, e-content and video lectures through digital platforms
Recognised degrees accepted for jobs and higher studies
Admissions twice a year, usually in the January and July sessions

eligibility.intro: Eligibility differs by programme, so always read the official details. In general:
items: Certificate and diploma: 10th or 12th pass, as specified
Bachelor's degree: 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised board
Master's degree: a bachelor's degree from a recognised university
Some programmes, like MBA or MCA, may have extra requirements
eligibility.note: Most programmes have no upper age limit, which makes IGNOU open to lifelong learners.

steps: Visit the official admission portal and register with your email and mobile number.
Select your programme and preferred regional centre.
Fill in your personal and academic details carefully.
Upload your photograph, signature and documents in the prescribed size.
Pay the fee online through debit card, credit card or net banking.
Submit the form and save the confirmation.

documentsRequired: Recent passport-size photograph and scanned signature
guide.studyMaterial: Upon entering into the course, you will start to receive the study materials for the courses, generally via computer, but in some courses in paper format. All courses contain assignments, and you will be required to submit the assignments to the centre, and they are marked. At the end of the term, the term-end examination is written. The university will announce the dates of the assignments and the exams, so be sure to check the notices regularly. Most students find that early completion of the assignments greatly reduces the stress of exam time.
guide.results: They also publish the results of the term-end exams on the official website of IGNOU after a few weeks of the exams. The result will appear paper-wise, showing the marks of each paper. The grade card is a gift for every student as you need it while applying for a job or further studies. If you find a mistake, report it immediately to your regional centre.
guide.regionalCentres: The university has a series of regional and study centres nationwide where you can obtain help, attend counselling and hand in assignments. Other forms of learner support include helplines, email support and a dedicated website for standard questions. Select a centre that is convenient – you'll actually visit it more than you anticipate, particularly during assignment and exam time – and develop a good relationship with your co-ordinator.
guide.commonMistakes: Small mistakes lead to big delays. Wrong marks, uploading 2MB of blurry documents or missing a deadline - these are common. Check the programme guide as it will tell you the precise rules regarding eligibility and fees. Never go by unofficial sites for dates, and don't ever pay someone who says he has a shortcut to admission or results.
tips: Apply well before the last date
Prepare electronically scanned documents for the right format
Select a regional centre near to you
Check your email and the official website for updates

Particular Details

What Is IGNOU MBA in HR Management?

The IGNOU MBA in HR Management is a two-year postgraduate management programme with human resources as the primary area of focus. It is offered through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) and online modes by the prestigious School of Management Studies (SOMS).

Why Choose IGNOU MBA in HR Management?

  • ✓ Unbeatable Affordability: Programme fees are far lower than private B-schools that charge ₹2 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh+.

  5. Fill out personal & academic details: Enter your educational background, graduation scores, and contact information accurately.
  6. Upload mandatory scanned documents: Upload your passport photograph, specimen signature, marksheets, and identity proof in the required dimensions.
  7. Pay the programme fee online: Submit the application registration fee (₹300) and first-semester tuition fee via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.

IGNOU admits students twice a year, in the January session and the July session.

  • 📝 Continuous Assessment (30% weightage): Each subject requires written assignments submitted to your regional study centre or online portal. Completing your assignments early significantly reduces exam stress.
  • ✍️ Term-End Examinations (70% weightage): Evaluated through pen-and-paper or digital designated test centres held twice a year (June and December).
  • 📊 Business Project Dissertation: In the final year, students complete an applied HR project report analyzing talent strategy or employee relations.

This degree provides a strong, officially recognized credential to boost your profile for managerial promotions.

Graduates with a recognized three-year bachelor's degree and at least 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories). No entrance exam is required.

Four semesters over two years, with flexibility to complete all course credits in up to four or five years.

4. What is the total fee?

About ₹66,000 for the full course (payable semester-wise: ₹16,000 each for semesters 1, 2, and 4; ₹18,000 for semester 3), plus a ₹300 registration fee and ₹200 per subject for term-end exams.

5. Is the degree valid?

Yes. IGNOU is UGC-DEB approved, AICTE recognized, and holds NAAC A++ accreditation. The MBA degree is recognized across India and worldwide for corporate jobs, public sector undertakings, and further studies.
